Name: JP's Artdew Valley Vol X - Lava Lamps
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ffff][u][center]Artdew Valley Vol X[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]﻿
[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Because... look at those colors, woooooooo![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[b][i][size=4]This mod consists of 12 volumes so far, this being the ninth of them. This volume focuses on adding 50 lava lamps. [/size][size=4]There are 5 varieties of Lava Lamps, each with 10 different colors of lava.[/size][/i][/b]

[list]
[*][size=4]You can get all the lamps at [color=#00ff00]Robin's store[/color] for the modest price of 750g to 1500g each.[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4]You can find at least 13 lamps per season, so you could get them all in a year.[/size]
[*][size=4]The models of lamps available are: Gray table lamp, gray mini table lamp, black table lamp, large black floor lamp and giant gold floor lamp. [/size]
[*][size=4]All lamps light up during the night and show a special 'animation' (simply the colors were edited to be brighter and match the light they emit). [/size]
[*][size=4]Each lamp has a different pattern of lava movement and also a different pattern in which they move.[b] [/b][/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size]
[color=#00ffff][size=5][b]Not much more to add, I hope you enjoy it![/b][/size][/color]
[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u][b]
Translations[/b][/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000][b]you don't need to ask my permission[/b][/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/size]
